dependencies.rationale: IEC 60086 is identified_not_acquired. Lithium classification must come from acquired manufacturer source. Using Panasonic datasheet only. If Panasonic does not explicitly establish broadLithiumClassification, dependency is unresolved and R2 fails closed.

rules.description: Enforces separation of regulatory obligations: obligations applicable to product-containing contexts must never be applied to loose battery contexts, and vice versa.
rules.currentStatusReason: Context separation is enforced structurally in regulatory-evidence.json. Rule engine validates the separation at evaluation time. Not yet activated pending rights review.
rules.note: This rule does not generate a positive regulatory claim. It enforces that product-containing obligations are never surfaced in loose_battery context output.
